description: A mixed set of exactly three plants and five animals for a classification exercise.

authoritativeText.text: 把图 18 中的集合分成植物和动物两类. 画出条形图.

inventory.description: Original PNG inspected independently: conifer, deciduous tree and sunflower (three plants); wolf, hare, bear, small canid and elephant (five animals). Existing clean artwork has three plants and five animals, replacing small canid with goat as an explicit neutral semantic-context substitution; classification task and 3:5 counts unchanged.
